text: Typeless is the best voice-to-text keyboard I've used. It's better than Google and definitely better than Siri or Bixby. I really just want to let the people working on this app know what a great job they're doing, because it picks up the things I say and formats them better than any other voice-to-text. It is twice as good as Google. It's quick, easy, and has a keyboardand I'm not even using the paid version yet!
